name: @cadence/ios
description: Cadence iOS shell (Capacitor). Wraps the cadence-web bundle (built with --mode ios); native calls flow through cadence-web's capability seam. Own workspace so the Xcode/Pods tree stays out of cadence-web's Vercel build root.

scripts.sync: npm run build:web && cap sync ios && npm run verify:bundle
scripts.run:ios: npm run sync && cap run ios
